explanation: Translates Apache Commons Validator 1.9.0 LuhnCheckDigit algorithm and its inherited ModulusCheckDigit behavior into Python. Blank/null checks mirror GenericValidator.isBlankOrNull using code.strip(). Luhn calculation doubles alternating digits from right to left (mod 2 indexing) and sums the digits. `calculate` raises ValueError on invalid inputs or exceptions, while `isValid` returns False.
